# 3. HLA LOH copy number -- results derived from /Users/wchen20/Desktop/2026-02-16_Draft/code/Revision/workflow/1_2_LOHHLA250804.md
```{r}
hlalohall_icgc <- fread(paste0(path_HLALOH, "/LOHHLA_icgc_all.csv"))
hlalohall_tcga <- fread(paste0(path_HLALOH, "/LOHHLA_tcga_all.csv"))

df_HLALOH <- rbind(hlalohall_icgc, hlalohall_tcga)

df_HLALOH <- df_HLALOH %>% subset(HLALOH == "Pos" & !is.na(Loss)) %>% 
  mutate(CN_1 = ifelse(round(HLA_type1copyNum_withBAFBin) < 0, 0, round(HLA_type1copyNum_withBAFBin)),
         CN_2 = ifelse(round(HLA_type2copyNum_withBAFBin) < 0, 0, round(HLA_type2copyNum_withBAFBin)),
         major = pmax(CN_1, CN_2),
         minor = pmin(CN_1, CN_2)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(LOHHLA_allele1, LOHHLA_allele2, HLA_type1copyNum_withBAFBin, HLA_type2copyNum_withBAFBin, PVal_unique, sample_id, AI, Loss, HLALOH, CN_1, CN_2, major, minor) %>% 
  distinct(sample_id, major, minor, .keep_all = TRUE)
length(unique(df_HLALOH$sample_id))
write.csv(df_HLALOH, paste0(path_HLALOH, "/df_HLALOH.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# 4. Summary
```{r}
df_HLALOH <- fread(paste0(path_HLALOH, "/df_HLALOH.csv"))

onco_hlaloh <- df_HLALOH %>% 
  filter(sample_id %in% sample_MSS) %>% 
  dplyr::select(sample_id, HLALOH) %>% distinct() %>% 
  mutate(value = "HLALOH") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample_id, values_from = value, values_fill = "") %>% 
  mutate(V1 = "HLALOH") %>% 
  dplyr::select(-"HLALOH") %>% column_to_rownames("V1")
dim(onco_hlaloh)
write.table(onco_hlaloh, paste0(path_HLALOH, "/onco_hlaloh.txt"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)
```
